ALASKA.AI · Dispatch ready · Not In The Buying

2026-08-08 · LinkedIn (primary) + TikTok · review, then post

The video

▼  Post to LinkedIn · 1:1 square (main feed)1080×1080 · 128s · H.264 MP4 · square stays in the home feed▼  TikTok · 9:16 (full-screen)1080×1920 · on LinkedIn this goes to the vertical Video tab, not the feed
For LinkedIn use the 1:1 square cut (top button) so the video lands in the main feed next to your caption. The 9:16 is TikTok-native, and uploaded to LinkedIn it gets pulled into the swipe-only Video tab instead of the feed.

Post text (copy/paste)

The post body only. Sources and credits are NOT in here on purpose, they go in the first comment (next block).
The feds designed this money in a way that is almost directing us to AI, a state legislator said. Then it bought X-ray machines.

Alaska got 272 million dollars this year from a federal program called Rural Health Transformation. Rep. Genevieve Mina, who sits on its advisory council, said that back in June.

The first awards landed on August 7th. Nineteen projects. Over 4.5 million dollars, which is under two percent of the year's money.

Chugachmiut, an Alaska Native nonprofit, got 627,200 dollars for portable X-ray machines in five rural clinics. Norton Sound Health Corporation got 292,100 dollars for a new scheduling system. Turnagain Community Health in Girdwood put 100,000 dollars toward a pharmacy testing medication kiosks.

Not one of the awards the Anchorage Daily News described uses artificial intelligence.

Three things cut against reading much into that. It is week one, and more than 267 million dollars is still undecided. Kodiak, the Yukon-Kuskokwim Delta and the North Slope got nothing in this round. The state's own award spreadsheet would not open for us, so every award figure here comes from one newspaper's reporting.

Then I went and read the federal law. Artificial intelligence appears in it exactly once. Not under equipment. Not under purchases. It sits inside a clause about training and technical assistance. Training people.

Mina read the pressure correctly. The rules really do bar new construction and broadband, and they cap capital at twenty percent of the award, which pushes money away from anything you have to build. The law just puts AI somewhere almost nobody looks for it.

That distinction matters more than it sounds. A state chasing AI procurement and a state building people who can run the tools will spend the same money and land somewhere very different by 2027.

The next batch goes out Friday.

If it were yours, would you buy the tools or train the people?

#Alaska #ArtificialIntelligence #RuralHealth #HealthPolicy #AIPolicy

Grade

  • panel median 7.47 (judges 7.52 / 7.47 / 7.13) against a 7.5 bar. Shipped under an owner release recorded in config/owner_release.json. Weakest axis is sound: no room tone, about a third of the SFX marks measure negative at their own timestamps, and the only ambience layer is a wind bed carried over from another episode.

Upgrades shipped this run

  • Seven checkers were reporting confidently on the wrong subject, and all seven printed a pass. text_fit_check measured a film that shipped on August 3rd; caption_band_check resolved a July episode through a stamp field nobody writes, then passed again by returning early on a missing constant; plate_overlap_check parsed zero scenes; claims_contract_check counted only failures; render_parallel.sh rendered Ep0803 when invoked with no argument, costing two and a half hours; the dead-window gate went blind when a foreground was added to fix a different finding; and crop_safety could not tell a wall-tile seam from a plate edge. Every one was caught by a human noticing a number looked wrong.
  • The standing rule that came out of it: a gate that can measure nothing must FAIL rather than pass, its pass line must carry the count of what it actually measured, and no gate may name a per-run target in a default.
  • NEW GATE vo_audio_check.py transcribes the mix we actually ship and applies the same banned-phrase list the script gate uses, because a surgical re-cut once left a corrected script beside uncorrected audio and a stale transcript later misrepresented the mix to a judge in the opposite direction.
  • NEW GATE caption_spelling_check.py fails when a phonetic respelling survives into the built props. "A I" reached the screen at 43.84s under a plate reading "AI".
  • NEW GATE content_sag_check.py measures the story region with the near field and caption card excluded, and independently reproduced a judge's two dead windows to within half a second.
  • The character rig's idle cycle never ran: its random seed was derived from an ANIMATED x prop, so the hash drawing the breath period and the whole weight-shift schedule was re-rolled every frame. Three rounds of judges measured that figure as frozen while the file plainly contained idle channels. Torso oscillation after detrending went 2.48px to over 10px.
  • The boot toe pointed backwards on every character in every episode.
  • FormGradient's default softness was 1, which puts the key and shade stops on the bounding-box corners, outside any non-rectangular shape. Across 56 places where an author chose a value the range is 0.42 to 0.9 and not one chose 1, while 62 sites took the default. Five panel rounds had cited the resulting flatness.
  • The film asserted a false claim about its own source: four award cards lit under DESCRIBED BY THE ANCHORAGE DAILY NEWS when the record enumerates six. Fixed by showing six, including Norton Sound's scheduling system, which was absent from the film entirely and is the award a sceptic would most suspect of being AI.
  • And the fix to a placeholder-bars note made the thesis card WRONG: adding an AI MENTIONS column turned every row label into a tabulated statutory claim, and CYBERSECURITY appears zero times in the entire evidence pack. The card now reads WHERE PEOPLE LOOK against IN THE STATUTE.
  • Plate geometry, bolt padding, rule-plate sub-lines and the closing labels are now DERIVED rather than hand-tuned. Six instances of the same overprint class turned up in one run.
  • The hero number now lands on its own words: the counter shared the money block's ramp and settled 5.6 seconds after the line that speaks it.
  • The poster was never chosen. encode_deliverables.sh grabbed frame 0, which here was an empty room.
  • The music credit no longer depends on remembering a flag; dispatch_email.py defaults it from music_credit.json.
